camel_example: aliyun vod UpdateMediaStorageClass --region cn-hangzhou --StorageClass Archive --MediaIds d56c2ac0cee271ed80004710b5ba0000
description_en: Modifies the storage class of a media asset
kebab_example: aliyun vod update-media-storage-class --media-ids d56c2ac0cee271ed80004710b5ba0000 --storage-class Archive --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMediaStorageClass

parameters.help_en:
The media IDs, which are audio or video IDs (VideoId). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported. You can obtain the IDs by using the following methods:
For audio or video files uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.
When you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential, the video ID is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
After the audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
媒体ID，即音/视频ID（VideoId）。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: media_ids

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the modification. If this parameter is not specified, the default value All is used. Valid values:
All (default): Applies tiered storage to all resources (source files and transcoded streams) of the media asset.
SourceFile: Applies tiered storage only to the source file of the media asset. Resources other than the source file use Standard storage
parameters.help_zh:
变更范围，不传则取默认值All。取值：
All（默认）： 将整个媒资的资源（源文件和转码流）做分级存储。
SourceFile：仅对媒资ID下的视频源文件做分级存储，源文件之外的资源为标准存储
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The storage class. Valid values:
Standard: Standard
IA: Infrequent Access
Archive: Archive
ColdArchive: Cold Archive
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型。取值：
Standard：标准
IA：低频（Infrequent Access）
Archive：归档
ColdArchive：冷归档
parameters.name: storage_class

parameters.help_en:
The restore priority (required only for ColdArchive media assets). If this parameter is not specified, the default value Standard is used. Valid values:
Expedited: Expedited
Standard (default): Standard
Bulk: Bulk
parameters.help_zh:
解冻优先级（仅冷归档媒资需要）。不传则取默认值Standard，取值：
Expedited：高级
Standard（默认）：标准
Bulk：批量
parameters.name: restore_tier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow storage class modification for media assets that have not met the minimum storage duration requirement. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false (default): Not allowed.

If the storage duration of a media asset is insufficient and you force a storage class modification, additional retrieval fees are incurred
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许存储时长不足的媒资进行存储类型变更。取值：

true：允许
false（默认）：不允许

如果媒资存储时长不足，强制进行存储类型变更，会涉及额外的取回费用
parameters.name: allow_update_without_time_limit

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Processing: Processing.
Failed: Failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Processing：处理中。
Failed：失败
